import numpy as np

# Observed Data
n_heads = 7
n_tails = 3

# Parameter Candidates
p_values = np.linspace(
    0.01,
    0.99,
    100
)

# Likelihood Function
likelihood = (
    p_values ** n_heads
    *
    (1 - p_values) ** n_tails
)

# Maximum Likelihood
best_index = np.argmax(
    likelihood
)

best_p = p_values[best_index]

print("Estimated p:", best_p)

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))

plt.plot(
    p_values,
    likelihood,
    label="Likelihood"
)

plt.axvline(
    x=0.7,
    linestyle="--",
    label="MLE = 0.7"
)

plt.xlabel("Parameter p")
plt.ylabel("Likelihood")

plt.title(
    "Bernoulli Likelihood Function"
)

plt.legend()
plt.grid(alpha=0.3)

plt.show()

log_likelihood = (
    n_heads * np.log(p_values)
    +
    n_tails * np.log(1 - p_values)
)

nll = -log_likelihood
